hypothesis: Recalibrated binpack labels. Paired measurement on identical positions showed the nodes5000pv2 search labels sit above Stockfish static eval by a magnitude-dependent factor, 3.56x below 50cp falling to 1.24x above 800cp, giving slope(label ~ static) 1.277 and explaining the slope ~1.2 that rc5 through rc9 all reached regardless of dose, learning rate or eval_scale. tools/bullet/bullet_recalibrate_labels.py inverts that map; on 2500 held-out positions it moves slope 1.286 -> 1.008 while leaving the genuine search-versus-static disagreement intact. This is rc5's exact regimen (same parent, 4000 superbatches, lr 1e-5, wdl 0.05, same 600M positions) with only the label calibration changed, so the audit isolates its effect. Expect slope near 1.0 with no output rescale, against rc5's 1.2012.
